content: 1. Stiripentol acts as both an inhibitor and inducer of the CYP3A4 enzyme. When co-administered with CYP3A4 substrates, monitor for either increased or decreased effects, as dosage adjustments may be necessary. 2. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of sufentanil by inhibiting hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Close monitoring is required due to the potential for enhanced effects. 3. Darunavir also increases the levels or effects of sufentanil via CYP3A4 inhibition. This interaction requires close monitoring, as the clinical significance is uncertain. 4. Co-administration of sufentanil with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors, such as cobicistat, may elevate sufentanil plasma concentrations, increasing the risk of adverse effects, including potentially fatal respiratory depression. Monitor closely. 5. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of sunitinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction necessitates close monitoring. 6. Cobicistat significantly increases the levels or effects of sunitinib through CYP3A4 inhibition. Alternative therapies should be considered due to the serious nature of this interaction. 7. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of suvorexant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Suvorexant is not recommended for use with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 8. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of tacrolimus by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Close monitoring is required. 9. Cobicistat also increases the levels or effects of tacrolimus via CYP3A4 inhibition. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. 10. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of tadalafil by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 11. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of tadalafil through CYP3A4 inhibition. For pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH), start tadalafil at 20 mg/day and increase to 40 mg/day if tolerated. Avoid tadalafil when initiating cobicistat. For erectile dysfunction (ED), limit tadalafil to a single dose of 10 mg within 72 hours. 12. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of talazoparib by inhibiting BCRP (Breast Cancer Resistance Protein). If co-administration cannot be avoided, monitor for adverse reactions. 13. Cobicistat decreases the effects of tamoxifen by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism, reducing its conversion to the active metabolite N-desmethyl tamoxifen. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 14. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of tamsulosin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 15. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of tasimelteon by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 16. Tazemetostat decreases the levels or effects of darunavir and cobicistat by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 17. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of tazemetostat by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 18. Tecovirimat decreases the levels or effects of darunavir and cobicistat by weakly inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 19. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of temsirolimus by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. 20. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of temsirolimus through CYP3A4 inhibition. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. 21. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of teniposide by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 22. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of teniposide via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 23. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of terbinafine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 24. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of terbinafine through CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 25. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of tezacaftor by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. 26. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of tezacaftor via CYP3A4 inhibition. Adjust the tezacaftor dosage regimen if co-administered with a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor. 27. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of theophylline by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 28. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of theophylline through CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 29. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of thioridazine by inhibiting CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. 30. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of tiagabine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 31. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of tiagabine via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 32. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of ticagrelor by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 33. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of ticagrelor through CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 34. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of timolol by inhibiting CYP2D6 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 35. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of tinidazole by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 36. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of tinidazole via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 37. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of tipranavir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 38. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of tipranavir through CYP3A4 inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. 39. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of tisotumab vedotin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 40. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of tisotumab vedotin via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 41. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of tofacitinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 42. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of tofacitinib through CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 43. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of tolterodine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 44. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of tolterodine via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 45. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of tramadol by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. 46. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of tramadol through CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 inhibition. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. 47. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of trazodone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 48. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of trazodone via CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 49. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of triamcinolone acetonide injectable suspension by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 50. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of triamcinolone acetonide injectable suspension through CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 51. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of triazolam by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 52. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of triazolam through CYP3A4 inhibition. This combination is contraindicated.
